topic: Adding day number to traffic queries
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the best method for passing a 'dayNumber' (the count of days in granularity or period) into existing traffic queries. Three options were evaluated: 1) Always return the field, ensuring it is available in all requests; 2) Add it to grouping columns, which might impact performance; and 3) Add a new field (`additionalSelectFields`) to the parameters object, which was deemed too limited for current needs.

The consensus reached was that Option 1 (always returning the field) is the simplest solution and will not negatively affect other parts of the system.
decisions: The 'dayNumber' field should be always returned in traffic queries.
